model_architecture: Hybrid XGBoost Champion + Unsupervised Isolation Forest

features.name: amount_minor
features.description: Monetary transfer amount stored strictly as integer minor units

features.name: velocity_instrument_60s
features.description: Rolling transaction count on instrument/UPI VPA within past 60 seconds

features.name: velocity_instrument_1h
features.description: Rolling transaction count on instrument/UPI VPA within past 1 hour

features.name: distinct_cards_ip_10m
features.description: Distinct card/VPA instruments attempted from source IP in past 10 minutes

features.name: distinct_cards_email_10m
features.description: Distinct card instruments attempted with customer email in past 10 minutes

features.name: amount_z_score
features.description: Normalized Z-score relative to user/merchant 30-day baseline

features.name: amount_ratio_30d
features.description: Ratio of current transaction amount vs 30-day rolling mean

features.name: account_age_days
features.description: Elapsed days since customer/account profile creation

features.name: hours_since_bank_change
features.description: Hours elapsed since bank account or payout destination modification

features.name: payout_to_balance_ratio
features.description: Ratio of payout requested to available ledger balance (ATO flag)

features.name: is_disposable_email
features.description: Binary flag indicating high-risk disposable or burner email domain

features.name: is_international_card
features.description: Binary flag indicating cross-border/international card issuance

features.name: hour_of_day
features.description: Local UTC hour of transaction initiation (0 to 23)
